definitions.explanation: Relating to or concerned with the welfare and dignity of human beings. Used especially in international affairs, disaster relief, and human rights contexts.

notes:
A formal word used in international affairs, news reporting, and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧ (humanitarian aid)
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (humanitarian crisis)
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦{見地|けんち}→見地：28981_kenchi⟧ (humanitarian standpoint)
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧ (humanitarian consideration)
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧ (humane treatment)

FORMS:
- {人道的|じんどうてき}な + noun (modifier: humanitarian ~)
- {人道的|じんどうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (adverbial: humanely)

The base word ⟦{人道|じんどう}→人道：16121_jindou⟧ means "humanity" or "humanitarianism."
